_comment_dryRunTimeoutMinutes: Instrumentation, not coverage analysis, is what makes the initial run slow: the suite is ~170s uninstrumented and exceeds 30 minutes with 6302 mutant switches inserted, measured both with perTest and with coverageAnalysis off, which timed out identically. Stryker's 5-minute default therefore aborts the whole run before a single mutant is tested. This is a ceiling, not a cost, and it sits well inside the job's 350-minute timeout. An initial run that needs more than this ceiling means the unsharded whole-surface run is infeasible and the work belongs in per-file shards, which is a finding worth failing on rather than absorbing into an ever-larger number.
_comment_ignorePatterns: Report artifact directories, none of which the tests read. Local allure-results alone holds ~422k files: unignored, ProjectReader spends ~100s walking them and the sandbox copy exhausts a tmpfs. A CI checkout is clean, so this matters for local iteration and costs CI nothing.
